title: Chief Economists Outlook
gist: Teaser page for a WEF Agenda Dialogues podcast briefing on the September 2026 Chief Economists Outlook, featuring economists from the World Bank Group, Indeed and ADP. It frames the global economy as facing significant disruption from multi-region conflicts, volatile bond markets and debate over future infrastructure, technology and investment, but gives no findings or data.

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum describes the global economy as navigating a period of significant disruption, driven by ongoing conflicts in multiple regions and volatile bond markets.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum (podcast page)
insights.so_what: Confirms bond-market volatility and geopolitical conflict as the consensus macro risk framing among institutional economists; monitor the full Outlook for quantified views.
insights.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a period of significant disruption, with ongoing conflicts in multiple regions, volatile bond markets

insights.claim: There is growing debate over which infrastructure, technologies and investments will shape the future economy, and the briefing asks how companies are adapting to these shifts.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum (podcast page)
insights.so_what: Signals capex and infrastructure allocation as an open debate among leading economists; watch for corporate adaptation evidence in the full Chief Economists Outlook.
insights.quote: growing debate over the infrastructure, technologies and investments that could shape the future

insights.claim: The September 2026 Chief Economists Outlook briefing features Ufuk Akcigit (World Bank Group, Deputy Chief Economist and Director of Private Markets), Svenja Gudell (Indeed Chief Economist), Nela Richardson (ADP Chief Economist and ESG Officer) and Saadia Zahidi (WEF Managing Director).
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum (podcast page)
insights.so_what: Labor-market data houses (Indeed, ADP) are on the panel, so the full Outlook likely carries hiring and employment views worth tracking.
